title: Celebrations Start 50 Days from the 50th Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks®
summary: Macy’s 4th of July Fireworks expands for its 50th anniversary, illuminating the iconic Brooklyn Bridge, the lower East River and the lower Hudson River, creating an unforgettable celebration on the nation’s 250th birthday This year, through “Celebrations Start at Macy’s,” Macy’s 4 th of July Fireworks ® will mark its 50 th anniversary with a milestone pyrotechnic display, captivating millions on Saturday, July 4. Macy’s 4 th of July Fireworks will expand to both the lower East River in the Seaport District, the lower Hudson River in collaboration with Jersey City, and the iconic Brooklyn Bridge creating a shared experience that connects more communities than ever. Celebrations Start 50 Days from the 50th Macy's 4th of July Fireworks® The nation’s largest 4 th of July celebration will ignite the skies of New York and New Jersey with a kaleidoscope of color and sound.
